movements.spokenClaim: Hephaestus at the bronze anvil with twenty bellows and Thetis
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Hephaestus at Bronze Anvil · 20 Bellows · Silver-Footed Thetis → 5-Fold Shield Frame
movements.activeSubtitle: First, beneath twenty roaring bellows, Hephaestus forged a shield both great[+67 → 736] and strong, adorning it all over.

movements.spokenClaim: Earth, Sky, Sea, untiring Sun, full Moon, and revolving Bear
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Central Cosmic Boss · Golden Sun · Silver Full Moon · Pleiades, Orion & Bear
movements.activeSubtitle: And the Pleiades, the Hyades, mighty[+5 → 2601] Orion, and the Great Bear, who revolves in her place and alone never bathes in Ocean.

movements.spokenClaim: Brides led beneath blazing torches with whirling dancers and doorway women
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: 3 Townhouses · Brides under Blazing Torches · Whirling Dancers · Doorway Women
movements.activeSubtitle: Beneath blazing pine torches they led brides from their[+11 → 2967] chambers as young men whirled to flutes and lyres, and women marveled at their portals.

movements.spokenClaim: Sacred circle of polished stones, elders with staves, two litigants & Two Talents of Gold
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Sacred Circle of Polished Stones · Seated Elders w/ Staves · Two Talents of Gold
movements.activeSubtitle: Therefore the elders sat on polished stones in a sacred circle,[+9 → 3443] rising in turn with heralds' staves around two talents of gold for the straightest judgment.

movements.spokenClaim: Besieged city wall, 1.6x golden Ares & Athena, two piping herdsmen & river ambush
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Besieged Wall · 1.6× Golden Ares & Athena · 2 Piping Herdsmen · River Ambush
movements.activeSubtitle: Crouched by the river watering-place,[+5 → 3739] they sprang upon two piping shepherds and their flocks, while Strife, Tumult, and crimson Fate dragged the fallen through the ford.

movements.spokenClaim: Thrice-ploughed golden field darkening behind yoked oxen & headland wine-cup
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Thrice-Ploughed Darkening Golden Furrows · Yoked Oxen · Headland Wine-Goblet
movements.activeSubtitle: And the earth grew black[+9 → 4107] behind the ploughshare like newly turned soil, though wrought of pure gold: a supreme marvel of the forge.

movements.spokenClaim: Reapers with sickles, sheaf-binders, oak feast & Silent King holding his sceptre
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Golden Wheat Swaths · Sickle Reapers · Sheaf-Binders · Silent King w/ Sceptre
movements.activeSubtitle: Among them the King stood in silence[+9 → 4536] with his scepter along the swath, rejoicing in his heart, while beneath an oak heralds prepared the feast.

movements.spokenClaim: Golden vines, black grapes, silver poles, kyanos trench & boy playing the lyre
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Golden Vines · Black Grapes · Silver Poles · Blue Kyanos Trench · Lyre-Boy
movements.activeSubtitle: In their midst a boy[+7 → 4940] played sweetly on a clear-toned lyre and sang the delicate Linus song in a slender voice as youths beat the earth in time.

movements.spokenClaim: Cattle of gold and tin by the river, 4 golden herdsmen, 9 dogs & 2 lions seizing the bull
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Gold & Tin Cattle by Reed-River · 4 Golden Herdsmen · 9 Dogs · 2 Lions Mauling Bull
movements.activeSubtitle: Four golden herdsmen urged on their nine swift hounds;[+12 → 5506] yet as the lions lapped the dark blood, the dogs stood close, barking and darting back.

movements.spokenClaim: Dancing-floor of Daedalus in Knossos spinning like a potter’s wheel around 2 tumblers
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: White Sheep in Mountain Glen → Knossos Choros Potter’s Wheel & 2 Whirling Tumblers
movements.activeSubtitle: Youths with golden daggers and garlanded maidens spun as swiftly as a seated potter trials his wheel between his palms, while two tumblers[+10 → 6172] whirled in the midst.

movements.spokenClaim: Complete 7,538-brick circular Shield sealed at the uttermost rim by River Oceanus
movements.sightBanner: VISIBLE: Complete 7,538-Brick Shield of Achilles Sealed by the Uttermost Rim of River Oceanus
movements.activeSubtitle: The bellows fell silent: a complete, breathing cosmos of seven thousand five hundred and thirty-eight bricks, sealed inside the armor of Achilles.[+32 → 7538]
